response.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_stats) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_win_rate AS difference FROM team_stats AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.avg_win_rate IS NULL), difference DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A record with zero games has an undefined win rate and is excluded from the average, as are records with missing wins or games.
